name: Parallel Bar Side Leg Raise
steps: Support yourself atop a dip station with straight arms, depressed shoulders, and straight legs hanging together.
Brace your core and lift your legs upward while tilting and curling your hips smoothly to one side to contract your obliques.
Lower your legs slowly back down to the center hang under full control.
Lift your legs toward the opposite side on the next repetition, alternating sides continuously.
tips: Keep your arms locked and shoulders active throughout the entire set.
Control every lowering phase so your body does not sway from side to side.
